Kento Alpha 0.8, build 1313

New nodes

  • Prerender (Other): renders its input to disk once and reads the frames back: to the shot's precomps (named and versioned as the Kura Write names them), Kento's cache, or files you choose. Use switches between the rendered frames and the live picture: on its panel, the chip on its tile, or Shift+D. Render, Render out of date (frames an edit upstream changed, and missing ones), Flipbook. The Flipbook's Make a Prerender after it puts one after the node.
  • Map Defocus (Filter > Blur and defocus): defocused by a map, 0 sharp to 1 the max size, in slices of Nuke's Defocus disc.
  • Highlight Suppress (Color): highlights rolled off to a white point above a knee, and Restore its exact inverse, for before and after a blur or defocus.
  • Edge Wrap (Filter > Light and glow): the background's light, and its highlights, wrapped into a foreground's edge.
  • Bloom (Filter > Light and glow): glows of doubling size added up, each weaker by the falloff.
  • A Nuke script gets each of these as a group of standard nodes that renders the same (Prerender: a Read of its frames). Highlight Rebuild now does too, instead of being baked.

Generative tools

  • Cambi, AutoDeband, Deflicker and WhiteBalance show what they measure (the score, the frame's mean and gain, the estimate) on their panels.
  • Grain says when its pattern has too few coefficients for its lag.

Playback

  • Parked on a frame, the Viewer no longer makes frames ahead; it does while playing, or always with Cache ahead while stopped (the playback chip, or Settings > Performance).

The look

  • A splash while Kento starts. The splash, About and the manual's cover carry K.O.

Kento Alpha 0.8, build 1296

New nodes

  • HighlightRebuild (Generative): where a highlight clipped in one or two channels and another still has detail, the clipped channels are rebuilt from it, by the channels' ratios nearby, so a sunlit cloud or chrome keeps its color and shape. Analyze reads each channel's clip level from the picture. Put it first, on the footage as it arrives.

Generative tools

  • Cambi's output channel and map scale are menus; VeryCanny's stability is a menu of frame counts.
  • Generate: model, size, aspect and backend are menus (the job's default first), the display space a color space menu, the prompt several lines, and a Generate... button that shows the price first.
  • Grain: Load Grain Table..., and its Scaling, Pattern and Chroma settings as folding sections.
  • Sliders over useful ranges (Deband's range, Halation's threshold, ChromaRebuild's epsilon, Grain's intensity); Linearise's primaries and reference white show only for BT2446A, WhiteBalance's power only where it acts.

Playback

  • J, K and L work over the Viewer, the Timeline, the Dope Sheet and the Curve Editor, and over the Viewer L no longer switches to luminance. L or J again plays faster (2x, 4x, 8x); K stops. Shift with the arrows steps 10 frames; Home and End go to the in and out points.

Node Graph

  • Dragging a selection from empty space draws a dashed box.

Kento Alpha 0.8, build 1292

Movies

  • A movie plays to its end: a Read made by the Shot panel, dropped, chosen in the browser or given a movie's path runs from frame 1 to the movie's frame count (it was 1 to 1, holding the first frame).
  • Movies decode much faster: frames are read in blocks, with the next block read ahead, so H.264 and H.265 plates cache and play at the comp's rate. ProRes and movies with alpha are unchanged.

New nodes

  • Despill (Keyer), the second of Kento's own nodes: pick the screen color from the Viewer; the despill math (average, maximum, minimum) and limit set how much comes out, restore and its color what goes back; the spill matte goes in alpha. A hue wheel under the screen color shows the screen, the primary it despills on, and the hues that lose color; drag the screen's dot to turn its hue. A Nuke script gets it as a group with one Expression node that renders the same.

Panels

  • The Read's first and last frame fields are visible again (they were under their hold menus).
  • Controls Kento doesn't build yet (the Read's File Type and Localization Policy) look dim as well as being off. The Read's hidden version knob no longer shows as a row.
  • A color control can pick from the Viewer: a click, or a drag for a box's average (Despill's screen color).
  • Kento's own nodes have the usual mask row.

Comps

  • New comps start at 23.976 fps (Settings > Preferences > General > New comps).
  • A .ko keeps the finishing nodes (AutoDeband and the rest) and the review grade nodes as themselves; they were saved as empty stand-ins and lost.
